  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (implies_congr (Eq.refl (IsCompact A))
        (implies_congr (Eq.refl (IsCompact B))
          (implies_congr (Eq.refl (Disjoint A B))
            (implies_congr _simp_1
              (implies_congr _simp_1
                (Eq.refl (∃ a₀ b₀, a₀ ∈ A ∧ b₀ ∈ B ∧ ∀ (a b : M), a ∈ A → b ∈ B → dist a₀ b₀ ≤ dist a b))))))))
